title: WorldStudios' Stoney Bois
description: Brings some stone blocks to life.
body:
Currently, this mod supports Minecraft 1.21.4 (NeoForge 21.4.137).

Welcome to yet another one of WorldStudios' Minecraft Mods! The point of this addon is to add walking Stone blocks called "Stoney Bois". Along with that, there is also a custom music disc and 2 new blocks!

Due to MCreator's limitations, I can only use NeoForge as the loader for this addon, so I'm sorry if you don't use NeoForge.
